title: US and Israel Strikes on Iran and Iran's Retaliatory Attacks on Israel and US Bases in Middle East Risk Catastrophic Regional War to World War 3, Warns Sardar Shaukat Ali Kashmiri
excerpt: Sardar Shaukat Ali Kashmiri, Chairman of the United Kashmir People's National Party, warns that recent joint strikes by the United States and Israel on Iran, and Iran's retaliatory attacks, could lead to a catastrophe with far-reaching global consequences.
author: Press Release

heroImage.caption: US and Israel Strikes on Iran and Iran's Retaliatory Attacks on Israel and US Bases in Middle East Risk Catastrophic Regional War to World War 3 — Warns Sardar Shaukat Ali Kashmiri

body.text: Sardar Shaukat Ali Kashmiri, Chairman of the United Kashmir People's National Party, has warned that the recent joint strikes by the United States and Israel on Iran, including the reported killing of Iran's Supreme Leader and senior military commanders, along with Iran's retaliatory attacks on US bases in the Middle East, could lead to a catastrophe with far reaching global consequences.

In a press statement issued from Bern, Switzerland on March 2, 2026, Sardar Shaukat Ali Kashmiri said that the joint military action inside Iran and the targeting of its top leadership risk plunging the region into prolonged instability and uncontrollable escalation.

body.caption: Sardar Shaukat Ali Kashmiri warns that a leaderless Iran could become even more dangerous and unpredictable than one led by a radical leadership.

body.text: A leaderless Iran could become even more dangerous and unpredictable than one led by a radical leadership. The sudden removal of central authority may trigger internal instability or civil war.

He extended heartfelt condolences to the Iranian people over the loss of their Supreme Leader and civilians and profound condolences and sympathy to families of victims who have lost their loved ones in the conflict.

Mr Kashmiri stated that a leaderless Iran could become even more dangerous and unpredictable than one led by a radical leadership. He warned that the sudden removal of central authority may trigger internal instability or civil war, drawing parallels with the aftermath of conflicts in Iraq and Libya, where regime collapse led to prolonged chaos and suffering.
International Law and UN Charter Violations

He said the world is at a moment of profound international urgency. The escalating confrontation involving the United States, Israel, and Iran threatens not only regional stability but also violates international law and the principles of the United Nations Charter upon which the international system is built.

"The United Nations was established to save succeeding generations from the scourge of war," he said. "Today we are witnessing a confrontation that risks expanding beyond borders, beyond alliances, and beyond control."
He noted that military strikes, retaliatory measures, and escalating rhetoric have created a volatile environment in which any miscalculation could trigger devastating consequences.
Sovereignty is not a selective principle. It is a cornerstone of international law. Political transformation in any nation must arise from the will of its people, not through external force.

Sardar Shaukat Ali Kashmiri stressed that sovereignty is not a selective principle. It is a cornerstone of international law. Political transformation in any nation must arise from the will of its people, not through external force. History shows that regime change imposed by military means rarely produces stability. Instead, it deepens grievances, fuels cycles of retaliation, and undermines long term peace.

He underlined that the human cost of war is already visible. Civilians are paying the highest price through displacement, economic hardship, trauma, and loss of life. Infrastructure is being destroyed. Global markets are shaken. International security is under strain. This is not a localized conflict. It is a matter of global concern.

He further stated that escalation serves no one. Prolonged warfare will not secure lasting safety for Israel. It will not guarantee strategic victory for the United States. It will not deliver dignity or stability for Iran. It will only bring further destruction of human life.

items: Full respect for international humanitarian law
Urgent diplomatic engagement under international mediation
Protection of civilian populations as a non negotiable priority

body.text: Sardar Shaukat Ali Kashmiri called for the following urgent steps: Immediate cessation of hostilities, full respect for international humanitarian law, urgent diplomatic engagement under international mediation, and protection of civilian populations as a non negotiable priority.

He said that under international law, no state has the right to intervene in another sovereign state to change its regime. In a democratic world, it is the right of the people of every country to elect their representatives. It is also the right of the people of that country to remove dictators or authoritarian regimes through their own internal political processes.
Past wars have resulted in the deaths of hundreds of thousands, the displacement of millions, widespread bloodshed, chaos, and the exploitation of resources and natural wealth.

He reminded the international community that past wars have resulted in the deaths of hundreds of thousands, the displacement of millions, widespread bloodshed, chaos, and the exploitation of resources and natural wealth.

Sardar Shaukat Ali Kashmiri urged the United Nations Security Council, peace loving nations, and international organizations to act immediately to de escalate the situation and prevent a wider war that could endanger millions of lives.
